#Filter out only adult respondants
```{python include=FALSE}
# Ensure RespAgeSimple is numeric
dT["RespAgeSimple"] = pd.to_numeric(dT["RespAgeSimple"], errors="coerce")

df.head()
```

```{python include=FALSE}
df = df[df['HousehNumPersU10'] > 0]
```

# Travel time in minutes ('Time of end of the journey'-'Time of start of the journey')
```{python echo=FALSE}
# Calculate travel time in minutes
df["TravelTimeMinutes"] = df["JEndTimeMsm"] - df["JStartTimeMsm"]

# Display first few rows
print(df[["JStartTimeMsm", "JEndTimeMsm", "TravelTimeMinutes"]].head())
```

#	Purpose of journey (the purpose of the longest staying time of the journey)
```{python echo=FALSE}
# Define categories for PrimTargetPurp
purpose_mapping = {
    1: "home residence",
    **dict.fromkeys([11, 50, 52, 53], "work and business"),
    **dict.fromkeys([12, 13, 14], "education"),
    **dict.fromkeys([20, 23, 31, 32, 33], "errands and shopping"),
    **dict.fromkeys([21, 22], "chauffeuring"),
    **dict.fromkeys([25, 38, 42, 43, 45, 47, 49], "leisure and social activities"),
}

# Filter first
df = df[df["PrimTargetPurp"].isin(purpose_mapping.keys())]

# Then map categories (no need for fillna anymore)
df["PrimTargetPurp_Cat"] = df["PrimTargetPurp"].map(purpose_mapping)


# Display first few rows
print(df[["PrimTargetPurp", "PrimTargetPurp_Cat"]].head(30))
```
# The number of children in the household and the age group of the oldest children
```{python echo=FALSE}
# Create "Numchld" column: Number of children in the household
df["NumChld"] = df["FamNumPers"] - df["FamNumAdults"]

# Create "AgeOldchld" column: Age category of the oldest child
df["AgeOldChld"] = df["PartyNum1017"].apply(lambda x: "10to17" if x >= 1 else "0to9")

# Create "Chldu6" column: Number of children under age 6 in the household
df["Chldu6"] = df["FamNumPers"] - df["FamNumPersO6"]

# Display first few rows
print(df[["FamNumPers", "FamNumAdults", "NumChld","PartyNumu10", "PartyNum1017", "AgeOldChld", "Chldu6"]].head(10))
```
# Household type (single-adult households, dual-adult households, and multi-adult households)
```{python, echo=FALSE}
# Create "HhStruct" column: Household structure categories
def categorize_hh(pos):
    if pos == 10:
        return "Single-adult household"
    elif pos in [11, 12]:
        return "Couple household"
    else:  # Includes 20 and NaN values
        return "Multi-adult household"

df["HhStruct"] = df["PosInFamily"].apply(categorize_hh)

# Display first few rows
print(df[["PosInFamily", "HhStruct"]].head(30))
```
```{python, echo=FALSE}
df = df[df['PosInFamily'] != 20]
```

#	Dummy for men/women in a couple, or younger/older
```{python, echo=FALSE}
# Dummies for position in couple
df["OlderInCouple"] = df["PosInFamily"] == 11
df["YoungerInCouple"] = df["PosInFamily"] == 12

# Dummies for gender
df["IsMan"] = df["RespSex"] == 1
df["IsWoman"] = df["RespSex"] == 2

df["OlderInCouple"] = df["OlderInCouple"].astype(int)
df["YoungerInCouple"] = df["YoungerInCouple"].astype(int)
df["IsMan"] = df["IsMan"].astype(int)
df["IsWoman"] = df["IsWoman"].astype(int)

print(df[["PosInFamily", "RespSex", "OlderInCouple", "YoungerInCouple", "IsMan", "IsWoman"]].head(10))
```
#	Dummy for work status in a couple 
```{python, echo=FALSE}
# Define function to classify occupation
def is_worker(code):
    return code in [210, 211, 221, 222]

# Apply the function to create the dummy
df["IsWorker"] = df["RespPrimOcc"].apply(is_worker).astype(int)

# Optional: create IsNonWorker dummy
df["IsNonWorker"] = 1 - df["IsWorker"]

# Preview result
print(df[["RespPrimOcc", "IsWorker", "IsNonWorker"]].head(10))
```
```{python, echo=FALSE}
# Count unique SessionIds by IsWorker status
worker_session_counts = df.groupby("IsWorker")["SessionId"].nunique()

# Convert to proportions
worker_session_proportions = worker_session_counts / worker_session_counts.sum()

# Display
print(worker_session_proportions)
```

#	Single-adult/ multi-adult categorical variable  
```{python, echo=FALSE}
# Create dummy for single-adult households
df["SingleAdult"] = df["FamNumAdults"].apply(lambda x: 1 if x == 1 else 0)

# Optionally: create the inverse dummy for multi-adult households
df["MultiAdult"] = 1 - df["SingleAdult"]

# Preview the result
print(df[["FamNumAdults", "SingleAdult", "MultiAdult"]].head(10))
```
# Check if the value of PartyNumu10 differs between trip level and journey level
```{python,  echo=FALSE}
# Group by JourneyId and TurId to see how PartyNumu10 varies
trip_level = df.groupby("TurId")["PartyNumu10"].first().reset_index()
journey_level = df.groupby("JourneyId")["PartyNumu10"].nunique().reset_index()

# Find JourneyIds where PartyNumu10 has more than one unique value across trips
journey_level_diff = journey_level[journey_level["PartyNumu10"] > 1]

# Merge back to original data if you want to inspect those JourneyIds
diff_details = df[df["JourneyId"].isin(journey_level_diff["JourneyId"])]

# Print summary
print(f"Number of journeys with inconsistent PartyNumu10 values: {len(journey_level_diff)}")
print(diff_details[["JourneyId", "TurId", "PartyNumu10"]].sort_values(["JourneyId", "TurId"]).head(20))
```
# Maximum number of accompanied children under 10 per journey
```{python echo=FALSE}
# Calculate maximum PartyNumu10 for each JourneyId
max_party = df.groupby("JourneyId")["PartyNumu10"].max().reset_index()

# Rename column for clarity
max_party.rename(columns={"PartyNumu10": "maxchldu10"}, inplace=True)

# Merge back into the main dataframe
df = df.merge(max_party, on="JourneyId", how="left")

# Preview the result
print(df[["JourneyId", "PartyNumu10", "maxchldu10"]].head(10))
```
```{python}
# Plot the histogram
bins = [-1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, float('inf')]
labels = ['0', '1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '5+']

df['maxchldu10Category'] = pd.cut(df['maxchldu10'], bins=bins, labels=labels, right=False)

chld_counts = df['maxchldu10Category'].value_counts().sort_index()

df['maxchldu10Category'] = pd.cut(
    df['maxchldu10'], bins=bins, labels=labels, right=False
    )
chld_counts = df['maxchldu10Category'].value_counts().sort_index()
```

# New variables ActivityTime and TransportDistance
```{python echo=FALSE}
# Calculate ActivityTime as TravelTimeMinutes minus SumMin
df["ActivityTime"] = df["TravelTimeMinutes"] - df["SumMin"]

# Set TransportDistance equal to SumLen
df["TransportDistance"] = df["SumLen"]

# Check the first few rows
print(df[["TravelTimeMinutes", "SumMin", "ActivityTime", "TransportDistance"]].head(10))
```

# Journey complexity (the number of tours in a journey: single trip or trip chaining)
```{python,  echo=FALSE}
# Create "JourneyComplx" column using .map()
journey_complexity = df.groupby("JourneyId")["TurId"].nunique().map(
    lambda x: "Trip Chaining" if x > 2 else "Simple Journey"
)

# Assign directly to avoid merging issues
df["JourneyComplx"] = df["JourneyId"].map(journey_complexity)

# Display first few rows
print(df[["JourneyId", "TurId", "JourneyComplx"]].head(10))
```

# Reduce the dimension (multiple rows in tour level in each journey -> single row for a journey)
```{python echo=FALSE}
# Define file paths
folder_path = r"C:\Users\ohdaw\OneDrive - Harvard University\tu_data"
data_file = os.path.join(folder_path, "data_before_compression.csv")  # Use latest dataset
output_file = os.path.join(folder_path, "data_reduced.csv")

# Load the dataset
dft = pd.read_csv(data_file, encoding="utf-8-sig")

dft["RespAgeSimple"] = pd.to_numeric(dft["RespAgeSimple"], errors="coerce")

# Filter to include only rows with variables
dft["ActivityTime"] = dft["TravelTimeMinutes"] - dft["SumMin"]
dft["TransportDistance"] = dft["SumLen"]

max_chld = dft.groupby("JourneyId")["PartyNumu10"].transform("max")
dft["maxchldu10"] = max_chld

dft["ActivityTime"] = dft["TravelTimeMinutes"] - dft["SumMin"]
dft["TransportDistance"] = dft["SumLen"]
dft["maxchldu10"] = dft.groupby("JourneyId")["PartyNumu10"].transform("max")

df_adults = dft[dft["RespAgeSimple"] >= 18].copy()

# Reduce to one row per JourneyId
df_reduced = df_adults.groupby("JourneyId").agg({
    "TurId": "first", 
    "JourneyWithChildren": "first", 
    "primode_cat" : "first", 
    "JStartTimeMsm": "first", 
    "JEndTimeMsm": "first", 
    "TravelTimeMinutes": "first", 
    "SumMin": "first", 
    "ActivityTime": "first", 
    "TransportDistance": "first", 
    "PrimTargetPurp": "first", 
    "PrimTargetPurp_Cat": "first", 
    "HousehNumPers": "first",  
    "HousehNumAdults": "first",  
    "NumChld": "first", 
    "PartyNumu10": "first",  
    "PartyNum1017": "first", 
    "AgeOldChld": "first",  
    "Chldu6": "first", 
    "HousehNumPersU10": "first", 
    "maxchldu10": "first", 
    "PosInFamily": "first",
    "SingleAdult": "first",
    "MultiAdult": "first",
    "OlderInCouple": "first",
    "YoungerInCouple": "first",
    "IsMan": "first",
    "IsWoman": "first",
    "RespSex": "first",
    "RespAgeSimple": "first",
    "IsWorker": "first",
    "IsNonWorker": "first",
    "JourneyComplx": "first",
}).reset_index()

# Assign Journey Complexity
df_reduced["JourneyComplx"] = df_reduced["JourneyId"].map(journey_complexity)

# Save the reduced dataset
df_reduced.to_csv(output_file, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

# Display first few rows
print(df_reduced.head(30))
```
